decision: Deferred and reverted. The narrow proof works, but adds compiler instructions without a meaningful measured compilation benefit; no full graph-analysis pass is justified by this experiment.
scope: Exact native intrinsic string/memory comparison bodies preserve optimizer memory facts; no ordinary source-name assumptions. Preparation before queued optimization, reset and disabled for watch/REPL, unsupported targets and debug.

limits: No latency improvement claimed; no laptop campaign, full suite or bootstrap repeated for this rejected experiment. Existing gates unchanged.
